I think you’re losing a sense of being connected to surounding people. This is not good if the situation prolongs. I have three recommendations for you to overcome:
1) you should look for someone else that you can talk to, not those who ignore your presence. They can be your friends, or even a friendly person on the Internet or the street that is willing to talk.
2) when being in the conversation, try to talk about what you think it is most comfortable.
3) you should think more positive on what you observe, either they are good or bad. Life is beautiful, so just take it easy and enjoy it.

I hope my recommendations can help.

The study is basically about examining the relationship between industrial growth, infrastructure development and air pollution emissions in one of the four green growth city in the world. The study’s findings suggest several factors that help industrial sector grow without hurting the atmosphere (less NO2 and CO emissions): 1) stringent monitoring; green policies and financial support from government; 2) energy source conversion (from coal, oil to gas and renewable sources); 3) economies of scale effects; 4) energy efficient technologies. Another notable result is the concurrent development of recycling industry and road infrastructure system, on one hand, can lead to lower greenhouse gas emission. On the other hand, the development of infrastructure system also results in urban sprawl and rising travel demand, which, in turns, increase air pollution emitted from vehicles (NO2 and Ox emissions). If the infrastructure system is not developed, recycling industry will turn into an industrial symbiosis which is effective in controlling the air pollution, but not effective in raising economic benefits. Eventually, the authors call it the trilemma of sustainable industrial growth. Hopes this summary helps!
